name: Floating Mantle Bluesting
tactics: Bluestings prefer to remain at a distance, surrounded by polyps. An injured or threatened bluesting might expel polyps in the stress of battle. It forms no attachment to such premature offspring, though, and leaves them to swarm foes while it launches waves of poisonous barbs.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

powers.name: Toxic Burst
powers.usageDetails: when first bloodied or whenever a floating mantle polyp within 5 squares of the bluesting drops to 0 hit points

effect.description: If the bluesting is accompanied by fewer than four floating mantle polyps, one polyp appears in flight in an unoccupied square within or adjacent to the burst. The polyp acts after the bluesting in the initiative count.

powers.name: Sudden Birth
powers.requirements: The bluesting must be accompanied by fewer than four floating mantle polyps.

effect.description: One floating mantle polyp appears in flight in an unoccupied square within 3 squares of the bluesting. The polyp acts immediately after the bluesting’s turn.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: creatures in the burst other than floating mantles

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target takes 10 psychic damage whenever it makes an attack against the bluesting (save ends).

powers.name: Sudden Explosion
powers.trigger: The bluesting is reduced to 0 hit points by fire or lightning damage.

hit.description: fire damage, and the bluesting pushes the target 1d4 squares.
